verdicts.reason: A shrinks the can to a small object in the middle, leaves a huge dead band between it and the CTA, and pushes the undersized Shop Sale pill into the bottom-left corner, so the CTA is buried. B keeps a strong CTA and a properly sized product, but the headline runs across the circle, the legal line has moved above the purple eyebrow so the reading order is wrong, and the left-aligned text block clashes with the centred can and button.

A keeps the original's can-over-circle pairing and groups headline, copy and CTA in one tight block, but the headline is now smaller than the product, the legal line sits above the eyebrow, and about 80px at the bottom is dead space. B has a bigger headline but sets it over the circle, also promotes the legal text above WEEKEND ONLY, and mixes left-aligned text with a centred can and button.

A shrinks the product to a tiny icon next to a small CTA at the very bottom, which wipes out the key image and leaves the middle of the canvas empty. B keeps the product and a strong CTA; its flaws are the headline over the circle, the legal line placed above the eyebrow, and the mixed left and centre alignment.

A has a properly sized product and a clear CTA; its flaws are the headline over the circle, the legal line above the eyebrow, and the mixed alignment. B shrinks the can to a tiny thumbnail floating inside the circle, which makes the product trivial, spaces the text block loosely, and leaves a large empty area below the CTA.
